```yaml
name: Sync PX4 Metadata

on:
  schedule:
    # Run daily at 06:00 UTC
    - cron: '0 6 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

# Restrict to mavlink org repositories
permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  sync-px4-metadata:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.repository_owner == 'mavlink'
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Download PX4 Metadata
        run: |
          mkdir -p src/AutoPilotPlugins/PX4
          mkdir -p src/FirmwarePlugin/PX4
          
          echo "Downloading airframes.xml..."
          curl -fSL -o src/AutoPilotPlugins/PX4/AirframeFactMetaData.xml \
            https://artifacts.px4.io/Firmware/_general/airframes.xml
          
          echo "Downloading parameters.xml..."
          curl -fSL -o src/FirmwarePlugin/PX4/PX4ParameterFactMetaData.xml \
            https://artifacts.px4.io/Firmware/_general/parameters.xml

      - name: Create Pull Request
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v8
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: "chore: update PX4 metadata from artifacts.px4.io"
          title: "chore: update PX4 metadata"
          body: |
            Automated update of PX4 airframe and parameter metadata.
            
            - Updated `src/AutoPilotPlugins/PX4/AirframeFactMetaData.xml`
            - Updated `src/FirmwarePlugin/PX4/PX4ParameterFactMetaData.xml`
            
            Source: https://artifacts.px4.io/Firmware/_general/
          branch: "chore/update-px4-metadata"
          delete-branch: true
          base: main
```
